name: @nemons/cli
description: Nemons — governed context, evidence, and verification service for coding agents, called over HTTP or MCP. It builds context packs from adopted personas, skills, and knowledge, collects evidence, runs heuristic verification, and stores experiences; it does not sit in the model's inference path and intercepts nothing by itself.
